what: Zero Inflated Negative Binomial model Using Gaussian Processes
title: Zero Inflated Negative Binomial model Using Gaussian Processes
text: package implements full Gaussian Process version model described “Framework Zero-Inflated Bayesian Negative Binomial Regression Models Spatiotemporal Data” Qing Hsin-Hsiung Huang (2023). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jspi.2023.106098, full details model appear “Imaging-derived spatiotemporal modeling landslide counts noisy Gaussian process random effects.” package work progress, feel free create issue suggestions notice problems.

title: Zero Inflated Negative Binomial model Using Gaussian Processes
text: Install devtools R package, run following command
code: install.packages(c("BayesLogit", "LaplacesDemon", "MASS", "Matrix", "msm", "mvtnorm")) devtools::install_github("KingJMS1/NNGP_ZINB_R")

title: Zero Inflated Negative Binomial model Using Gaussian Processes
text: Detailed examples full code can found vignettes folder, source data can found experiments repository: https://github.com/KingJMS1/ZINB_R_Experiments. Given , predictions can found via: spatial temporal design matrices, along y can created matrix-format y (rows spatial locations, columns temporal locations) via make_y_Vs_Vt.
code: X          Other Predictor variables y          Zero inflated count response coords     Spatial coordinates for GP Vs         Spatially varying predictor variables            (e.g. one-hot indication of which location this is for varying intercept),            wrapped in sparseMatrix from Matrix R package.            Will be multiplied by the spatial random effects for prediction. Vt         Temporal varying predictor variables, wrapped in sparseMatrix from Matrix R package.            Will be multiplied by the temporal random effects for prediction. Ds         Spatial distance matrix, diagonal should be 0,            off diagonal is distance between elements i and j in space, inputs to the spatial GP kernel Dt         Temporal distance matirx, diagonal should be 0,            off diagonal is distance between elements i and j in time, inputs to the temporal GP kernel nsim       How long to run MCMC in total, must be greater than burn. burn       How long to run MCMC before saving samples. thin       Thinning ratio for chain, increase if running out of memory. ltPrior    Prior for temporal length scale, formatted as: list(max=50, mh_sd=3, a=1, b=0.001). a/b for gamma prior, max sets how high it is allowed to go, mh_sd controls the proposal variance for mh. lsPrior    Prior for spatial length scale, formatted the same as ltPrior. sigmaPrior Prior for sigmas in model, formatted as: list(a=0.01, b=0.1), inverse gamma prior noisePrior Prior for signal to noise ratio, formatter as: list(a=1.5, b=1.5, mh_sd=0.2), mh_sd controls the proposal variance for mh. mh_sd_r    Control mh proposal variance for r to deal with convergence issues kern       Covariance kernel, takes a squared distance matrix, returns kernel covariance. library(ZINB.GP) output <- ZINB_GP(X, y, coords, Vs, Vt, Ds, Dt, nsim, burn, save_ypred = TRUE) predictions <- output$Y_pred

title: ZINB_GP — ZINB_GP
text: X Fixed-effect design matrix one row per observation. y Non-negative integer count response. coords Spatial coordinates used legacy spNNGP implementation. nsim Total number MCMC iterations; must exceed burn. burn Number burn-iterations. use_count_gp Whether include GP random effects count component. use_inflation_gp Whether include GP random effects zero-inflation component. thin Store every thin-th iteration burn-. kern Kernel function accepting distance matrix length scale. save_ypred Whether save posterior predictive draws. print_iter Print progress every print_iter iterations. print_progress Whether print MCMC progress. Vs Spatial random-effect design matrix one row per observation. Vt Temporal random-effect design matrix one row per observation. Ds Spatial distance matrix; diagonal must zero. Dt Temporal distance matrix; diagonal must zero. ltPrior List max, mh_sd, , b temporal length-scale prior proposal controls. lsPrior List max, mh_sd, , b spatial length-scale prior proposal controls. sigmaPrior List b inverse-gamma prior parameters GP scales. noisePrior List , b, mh_sd GP noise-ratio prior proposal. mh_sd_r Proposal standard deviation negative-binomial dispersion parameter.

title: ZINB_GP — ZINB_GP
text: list containing posterior MCMC draws: Alpha Fixed-effect coefficients zero-inflation component. Beta Fixed-effect coefficients count component. , B Spatial temporal random effects zero-inflation component. C, D Spatial temporal random effects count component. L1t, L2t Temporal GP length scales zero-inflation count components. Sigma1t, Sigma2t Temporal GP scale parameters. Phi_bin, Phi_nb Spatial GP length-scale parameters. Sigma1s, Sigma2s Spatial GP scale parameters. R Negative-binomial dispersion parameter. at_risk -risk indicator draws observation. Y_pred Posterior predictive draws, NULL save_ypred FALSE.
